result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Vendor indemnifies Customer and its Affiliates for third-party IP claims, Vendor legal violations, Vendor-caused Customer Data incidents, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct; Customer's indemnity is confined to Customer-provided materials and legal violations; and customary notice, defence-control, cooperation, settlement, IP-exclusion, and remedy provisions are included. No 3× cap is required because the preferred, rather than fallback, position is achieved. The changes are appropriately confined to adding the missing indemnity framework and preserve the existing provisions. Drafting quality is reduced because the new text refers to Section 20.1(a), but the rendered indemnity paragraphs are not numbered, making the cross-references facially defective; the margin comment also references Sections 9.3 and 20.5 inconsistently with the rendered text.
